pinned_source.title: Utilitarian Mechanism Design for Single-Minded Agents
pinned_source.locator: Figure 3, Greedy-2; multi-unit combinatorial auctions among unknown single-minded bidders
pinned_source.license: No source-code license asserted; clean-room mathematical implementation

input.bundle_mask_rule: Nonzero bit mask with no bits above item_count-1; bit e requests item e.

contract.algorithm: Greedy-2; initialize y_e=1/b_e, repeatedly select the remaining bidder maximizing value_i/sum_{e in bundle_i} y_e, update each requested y_e by (e^B*m)^(1/b_e), and stop when sum_e b_e*y_e >= e^B*m or bidders are exhausted; B=min_e b_e and m=item_count.
contract.tie_rule: Lower input bidder index wins an equal ratio.
contract.numeric_model: IEEE-754 binary64 for the source algorithm's exponential price updates; workloads avoid near ties.
contract.profile_scope: Allocation loop only; no payment computation or empirical truthfulness claim.
